Otters Return to Kuala Lumpur River, Signaling Environmental Improvement

The return of otters to the Klang River in Kuala Lumpur is being seen as a positive sign for the river's environmental revival. This wildlife, previously absent due to pollution, has reappeared, sparking hope for the ongoing efforts to clean up and restore the river's ecosystem. The presence of otters indicates a significant improvement in water quality and the overall health of the river.
